scope: Architecture audit only; no code changes made

final_answers.what_prevents_it_today: No generic domain-intake and ontology-to-objective compiler exists for unseen business domains.

phase_audit.implementation: Decision ontology and objective stack exist, but only for pre-modeled senior-care motions.
phase_audit.missing_evidence: Generic business-domain-to-problem compiler for arbitrary domains.
phase_audit.runtime_proof: Current objective stack exists for Launch Nevada; no proof for Employment Matching, Mortgage Advisors, Vehicle Selection, or Insurance.

phase_audit.implementation: Objective records contain business_goal and current task, but only for pre-modeled objectives.
phase_audit.missing_evidence: Automatic decision-target derivation from arbitrary business-domain input.
phase_audit.runtime_proof: Objective dashboards show current work and blocker for existing objectives.

phase_audit.implementation: The ontology review and architecture docs define decision factors, evidence groups, and parameter semantics.
phase_audit.missing_evidence: Runtime ontology discovery for new business domains.
phase_audit.runtime_proof: No runtime proof that a new domain produces a newly discovered ontology.

phase_audit.implementation: Existing objectives reuse existing capabilities, but only for the current catalog.
phase_audit.missing_evidence: Reuse mapping for unseen business domains.
phase_audit.runtime_proof: Launch Nevada reuses source_intelligence, market_builder, canonical_universe, provider_intelligence, media_intelligence, and recommendation_decision_engine.

phase_audit.implementation: Existing agents are cataloged and traced, but many are domain-specific or unproven.
phase_audit.missing_evidence: A generic agent selection layer for arbitrary domains.
phase_audit.runtime_proof: Agent registry and supervisor metrics exist, but not a universal agent broker.

phase_audit.implementation: Source intelligence, source lifecycle, and policy docs exist.
phase_audit.missing_evidence: Generic source planner for new domains and new source classes.
phase_audit.runtime_proof: Source lifecycle and policy artifacts exist for the current platform.

phase_audit.implementation: Outcome learning, evidence validation, and narrative generation exist as separate domains.
phase_audit.missing_evidence: Cross-domain learning stage planner that can be derived from any domain.
phase_audit.runtime_proof: Learning lanes are described in architecture docs and in current objectives.

phase_audit.implementation: Canonical universe and platform registry exist, but they are focused on current senior-care entities.
phase_audit.missing_evidence: Canonical planning for arbitrary business entities.
phase_audit.runtime_proof: Current objective stack uses canonical_universe as a milestone.

phase_audit.implementation: Assessment planning exists for family/advisor intake.
phase_audit.missing_evidence: Generic assessment planner for non-senior-care domains.
phase_audit.runtime_proof: Assessment experience is already an existing capability.

phase_audit.implementation: Matching logic exists in the current product, but it is senior-living-specific.
phase_audit.missing_evidence: Universal matching planner for arbitrary business domains.
phase_audit.runtime_proof: Current registry exposes recommendation_decision_engine in objectives.
phase_audit.blocking_dependency: New domain ontology and objective model

phase_audit.implementation: Validation artifacts and tests exist for current platform behaviors.
phase_audit.missing_evidence: Generic validation planner that derives validation stages from arbitrary domains.
phase_audit.runtime_proof: Focused tests prove current registry/objective gating works.

phase_audit.implementation: Execution planning exists for current objectives and capabilities.
phase_audit.missing_evidence: Automatic execution-plan generation for unseen domains.
phase_audit.runtime_proof: Current active objective, current milestone, current executable capability, assigned agent, and task are generated.
phase_audit.blocking_dependency: Objective must already exist in registry

phase_audit.implementation: Business progress and objective dashboards are generated automatically.
phase_audit.missing_evidence: None for the current tracked objectives.
phase_audit.runtime_proof: business_completion, current_active_objective, and milestone data are present.

phase_audit.implementation: Objective dashboards and current objective stack are already persisted and rendered.
Supervisor cycle, watchdog, incidents, and dependency checks already exist.
phase_audit.missing_evidence: No missing evidence for existing supervisor workflows.
phase_audit.runtime_proof: The supervisor exposes business progress and current objective stack.

phase_audit.implementation: Registry payload, markdown, JSON, and gating helpers already exist.
phase_audit.missing_evidence: No missing evidence for current registry workflows.
phase_audit.runtime_proof: Registry build artifacts were generated and validated.

phase_audit.implementation: The constitution is explicit and repeatedly referenced, but not yet a generic runtime pre-check for arbitrary new domains.
phase_audit.runtime_proof: Principle Impact Checks exist in architecture docs; registry/supervisor enforce current objective work.

constitution_enforcement.reason: Constitutional doctrine and impact checks exist, but there is no universal runtime domain-intake validator for arbitrary new business domains.
